(Japanese: '''ポケモンレンジャーバトナージ:まんがでミッションクリア''' ''Pokémon Ranger Vatonage: Mission Clear'') is one of the {{pkmn|manga}} adaptations of [[Pokémon Ranger: Shadows of Almia]]. It was created by よしのえみこの [[Emiko Yoshino]]. It appeared in Maru Maru Comics (マルまるコミック) volume 4 - 8 (April 2008 - August 2008).
